endorsements.name: AVM Amorn Chomchoey
endorsements.label: WELCOME NOTE
endorsements.description: Air Vice Marshal Amorn Chomchoey, is the Secretary General, of the National Cyber Security Agency of Thailand and Executive Director of Cyber Operations for the Royal Thai Air Force Cyber Center. He was previously Director of the Cyber Warfare Division of the Royal Thai Air Force in the Department of Information and Communication Technology.
endorsements.assessor: HITB (Hack In The Box Security Conference)
endorsements.subtitle: HITB 2023

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
